response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web engineer, but the role requires native-level Japanese, strong C for UNIX embedded development, Linux kernel source-code analysis, and networking/security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His C/C++ experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint over a decade ago, and his career trajectory has moved firmly toward web/product development rather than embedded firmware. The Japanese language requirement alone appears disqualifying.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some low-level/systems exposure via DLang low-latency services and C/C++ work at National Instruments
Linux proficiency and dev-environment/tooling setup experience (Docker, CI servers, Kubernetes)
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language ability, a hard requirement (native-level)
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, network switch, or security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF) experience
C programming experience is minimal and dated; current focus is TypeScript/Node.js web development

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or Linux kernel experience
Strong general engineering seniority and Linux familiarity
